Recall record from the CPSC recalls database (saferproducts.gov):

Product: Gamewell-FCI fire alarm panels (ILI-MB-E3 and ILI-S-E3)
Description: This issue is limited to a specific configuration of Signaling Line Circuit (SLC) devices. To occur, the SLC must include at least two of the following detectors in any combination: Acclimate, 4-Warn, Photo/CO and iFAAST. The issue would occur only if the detectors are addressed within the same FlashScan polling group. Detectors installed in a different combination are not affected.
Defect: When configured in a certain way, the panels can become non-responsive and connected detectors in the area can fail to detect and respond to an alarm.
Incidents: No incidents or injuries have been reported.
Recall date: 2016
